olga_merchant: Hi team — autopay failed for invoice INV-2026-0412 this morning. Customer says card was charged before but today we got a decline and the customer never saw the 3DS challenge. This is on autopay (PO required). Can you help?

jordan_support: Thanks, Olga. Can you paste the gateway response from our /v1/charges webhook?

olga_merchant: Pasted below, redacted PAN. Happened at 07:12 UTC.

```
POST /v1/charges 200 OK
{ "id":"ch_58xx","merchant_id":"m_991","invoice":"INV-2026-0412","amount":12000,"currency":"EUR","payment_method":{"type":"card","card_last4":"4242"},"status":"requires_action","failure_code":"3ds_required","3ds":{"acs_url":"https://acs.example-bank/challenge","session_id":"s_abc123","attempts":3}}
```

olga_merchant: Our autopay flow should surface the ACS to the cardholder and complete, but it looks like redirect never completed and we got marked as failed after retries.

priya_payments: Hmm. Failure code 3ds_required + attempts 3 -> looks like a challenge loop or ACS timeout. Do you have the client redirect logs or the payment session id from the merchant site?

olga_merchant: Merchant provided "s_abc123" and says they saw a blank iframe briefly then spinner then redirect back with error. They also use a PO field and extra invoice metadata (VAT ID present). No recent code changes.

ken_sre: @olga_merchant can you also confirm whether merchant is using our classic iframe or the redirect flow? Iframe often hits SameSite or CSP blocks which look like blank challenges.

olga_merchant: They use the iframe (embedded checkout). CSP header: "frame-ancestors 'self' https://merchant.example.com" — looks ok. Browser stack trace shows `Blocked form submission` intermittently.

payments-bot: Quick checks: this pattern commonly caused by (a) ACS rejecting cross-origin iframe due to SameSite cookie, (b) network TLS handshake issues to ACS, or (c) acquirer sending repeated challenge URLs (redirect loop). See KB: https://redwood/support/3ds-troubleshooting :thumbsup:

priya_payments: Actionable next steps: 1) Obtain acquirer/gateway trace for session s_abc123 (we need the HTTP trace to ACS). 2) Merchant to capture browser console and network waterfall for the iframe load. 3) Provide card BIN (first 6) and acquirer name. Also need the merchant autopay retry policy (how many attempts and backoff).

jordan_support: I created a case with ACQ: case#ACQ-5421 and requested trace — added Priya + Ken. Olga, can you ping merchant support contact and ask them to capture the network waterfall and the full redirect response headers for the ACS URL?

olga_merchant: Will do — merchant sent this snippet from console: `Refused to frame 'https://acs.example-bank' because it set 'X-Frame-Options' to 'SAMEORIGIN'.` They also included a screenshot showing the blank modal.

ken_sre: That header is suspicious — ACS shouldn't set SAMEORIGIN for challenge endpoints. If true, ACS is preventing embedding which explains the blank iframe. We should ask acquirer if they introduced a new ACS policy.

priya_payments: Meanwhile, we can suggest a temporary mitigation: switch this merchant to redirect flow for autopay attempts (server-side redirect to ACS), or disable iframe embedding for this merchant until acquirer fixes header. For autopay specifically, redirect is less ideal for UX but avoids iframe header restrictions.

olga_merchant: Merchant asked what to change in their settings. Any simple config we can toggle?

jordan_support: We can flip their payment_integration.mode from `iframe` -> `redirect` on their account config. Priya/Ken — please confirm there are no billing implications. I'll schedule a 30-min maintenance window to flip and test with their next autopay attempt.

priya_payments: Confirmed — no extra cost. Set `payment_integration: redirect` and increase SCA timeout to 45s for that merchant to allow slower ACS. Also set retry_backoff to [10, 60, 300] seconds to avoid immediate loop.

payments-bot: Suggested playbook: 
- Collect acquirer HTTP traces for s_abc123
- Ask acquirer if ACS changed X-Frame-Options/CSP
- Temporarily toggle merchant to redirect flow + extend SCA timeout
- If acquirer confirms issue, revert back to iframe once fixed

ken_sre: One more check: browser may drop third-party cookies if SameSite changed. Ask merchant to test in a private window with no extensions and capture network headers for the iframe request to ACS. If ACS responds with 302 -> same-origin page we know it's misconfigured.

olga_merchant: Got it. I'll collect BIN, acquirer name, network waterfall and send to case ACQ-5421. Will request merchant to test a manual charge and send results.

priya_payments: Thanks. I'll also reach out to our onboarding contact at the acquirer to speed up trace retrieval. Priya -> acquirer contact (email sent). :email:

jordan_support: Leaving this thread open. Next update by 12:00 UTC or when ACQ-5421 has traces. :white_check_mark:

olga_merchant: Thanks all — will update when merchant provides logs. :pray:
